description: The SAME friendly mint hooded GameNight mascot as reference, same small round cream face and black dot eyes, identical head/body proportions, tiny sprout on hood. Full body standing facing right in side-view platformer pose. Change only outfit: mint teal pilot jacket, cream collar, small amber scarf and pilot goggles resting ABOVE the face on the hood, dark little boots. No props apart from worn equipment, no floor, no shadow, no lettering. Face must remain unobscured.
style_description: Crisp 96x96 pixel-art game sprite. Same mint/cream palette, dark outline, rounded cute tiny body as reference.
